# Morning Briefing – Night 1

> **High‑priority Open Item**  
> • **Read/Review MemGPT** – https://arxiv.org/abs/2301.12345  
>   *Rationale:* Captures core ideas on virtual context management, a key component for your memory‑rewrite concept.  
>   **Deadline:** by end of Day 2.  
>   **Draft:** “I’ve skimmed MemGPT: the paging model leverages an external memory store to extend in‑context capacity.  Key takeaways: (1) eviction policy, (2) retrieval weighting, (3) integration with GPT‑3.5.  Need to map to your rewrite‑buffer algorithm.”  

> **Next Action** – Summarize relevant sections (≈150 words) and outline how to embed the paging mechanism into your rewrite loop. Publish the draft in the shared repo.  

> **Commitment Nudge** – Allocate 1 h tomorrow morning to write the summary; set a calendar reminder.  

> **Hypotheses / Insights** – No hypotheses entered yet.
